    What is Rick Pitino's salary?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Rick Pitino signed a six-year, roughly $20 million contract to become the head coach at St. John's University in 2023, averaging approximately
    $3.3 million to $3.5 million per year. As of March 2026, reports indicate St. John's is restructuring this deal to make him the second-highest-paid coach in the Big East Conference. 
    Key Details on Rick Pitino's Salary: 
    • Contract: 6 years, ~$20 million (beginning 2023–24 season).
    • Annual Salary: Reported between $3 million to $3.5 million, with new offers looking to increase this amount.
    • Conference Standing: As of 2024-25, he was roughly the 6th highest-paid coach in the Big East, with new negotiations aiming to place him second behind UConn's Dan Hurley
      .
    • Comparison: This is significantly lower than his previous position at Louisville, where he earned over $7.7 million annually, notes this Diario AS article. 
    Note: This information refers to Rick Pitino (St. John's). His son, Richard Pitino, is the head coach at New Mexico.
